author: agent
sentences: I have maintained a small open source library since 2019.
It is a date parser that nobody notices until it breaks.
Last week the project passed 12,000 stars, which still surprises me.
Most of the stars came from one blog post I never expected to spread.
If you maintain something, write down how you make decisions.
notes: stars over 1,000; since 2019 is a year and no event
